headline: US Imposes Restrictions on Military and Defence Cooperation With Canada
summary: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth issued a classified directive restricting military cooperation with Canada to refocus bilateral ties around American defence priorities, according to US media reports.
why: US-Canada defence ties anchor the NORAD continental security pact and influence North American cross-border defence procurement.

impacts.name: Canadian Dollar
impacts.why: Growing US-Canada diplomatic and security friction creates headwinds for bilateral cooperation.
